# Vortex Dispatch

> Vortex Dispatch is a software engineering company in Cape Town, South Africa. We build and operate production software using agent-orchestrated engineering systems: specialised AI coding agents coordinated across planning, implementation, review, QA and delivery, with human engineering governance. We are not a transport, trucking, or fleet-dispatch service.

Canonical site: https://vortexdispatch.co.za
Open-source model: https://vortexdispatch.co.za/open-source
Contact: hello@vortexdispatch.co.za
Location: Cape Town, South Africa
Founded: 2024

## What is VXD?

VXD is the open-source AI coding-agent orchestration project maintained by Vortex Dispatch.

Repository: https://github.com/tzone85/vortex-dispatch
License: Apache License 2.0

VXD coordinates coding-agent workflows across requirement planning, dependency-aware stories, isolated git worktrees, implementation, review, QA and delivery. It is a genuine standalone open-source developer tool.

## Open-source and private software factory

Vortex Dispatch uses an open-core model.

Public:
- VXD agent orchestration
- provider/runtime integrations
- git worktree isolation
- review and QA workflows
- dashboards, diagnostics and recovery tooling

Private:
- commercial production policies
- proprietary prompts and optimisation heuristics
- customer-specific governance and deployment controls
- cross-project learning and accumulated operational intelligence
- private software-factory systems used for commercial delivery

The public and private systems do not need feature parity. VXD is intended to remain useful open-source software without publishing every internal production technique used by Vortex Dispatch.

## What we do for clients

- Custom software and web application development
- AI-native and agent-orchestrated software engineering
- Booking systems and payment-enabled platforms
- Marketplaces and staffing platforms
- Compliance and document-generation products
- Internal business systems, integrations and automation
- Ongoing hosting, monitoring, support and iteration

Clients buy software outcomes and engineering capability. They do not need to adopt VXD or Vortex Dispatch's private factory systems.

## Selected products we built and run

- Mini Suites: booking platform for a short-stay rental business
- ShiftSavvy: same-shift staffing marketplace for restaurants
- FoundersDesk: company document and compliance product
- ReturnReady: SARS filing-season co-pilot
- SpeedReading: interactive speed-reading trainer
- Sovereign Breath: offline-first breathwork PWA

## Engagement

Vortex Dispatch scopes and builds production software for businesses and engineering teams. Commercial engagements can include complete product delivery, engineering pilots, ongoing operation and maintenance, and agent-orchestrated engineering implementations.
